headline: 7 AL leaders including Obaidul Quader sentenced to death for crimes against humanity
summary: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 has sentenced seven fugitive leaders of the banned Awami League and its affiliates to death for crimes committed during the July uprising.
details: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 on Tuesday sentenced seven fugitive leaders to death for crimes against humanity committed during the July mass uprising. Among those sentenced are Obaidul Quader, General Secretary of the banned Awami League, and former State Minister for Information and Broadcasting, Mohammad Ali Arafat.
caption:
7 fugitive leaders, including Obaidul Quader, sentenced to death for crimes against humanity.

The International Crimes Tribunal-2 on Tuesday sentenced seven fugitive leaders to death for crimes against humanity committed during the July mass uprising. Among those sentenced are Obaidul Quader, General Secretary of the banned Awami League, and former State Minister for Information and Broadcasting, Mohammad Ali Arafat.

headline_marked: [[Crude bomb explodes in front of Supreme Court]] after death penalty verdict
headline: Crude bomb explodes in front of Supreme Court after death penalty verdict
summary: The blast occurred Tuesday afternoon near the entrance used by the Chief Justice and other judges, following a ruling against AL leaders.
details: A crude bomb exploded on Tuesday afternoon in front of the Supreme Court, specifically near the entrance used by the Chief Justice and other judges.

The incident occurred shortly after the court announced the death penalty for seven defendants, including Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader, for crimes against humanity during the July mass uprising.
CCTV footage shows two individuals on a motorcycle arriving at the main gate, where the passenger threw the crude bomb before fleeing.
Police are currently reviewing the footage and investigating the incident to identify and take action against those involved.
The Home Minister has stated that two individuals responsible for the blast have already been identified.
caption:
A crude bomb blast rocked the entrance of the Supreme Court today, following a high-profile death penalty verdict.

A crude bomb exploded on Tuesday afternoon in front of the Supreme Court, specifically near the entrance used by the Chief Justice and other judges.

The incident occurred shortly after the court announced the death penalty for seven defendants, including Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader, for crimes against humanity during the July mass uprising.

CCTV footage shows two individuals on a motorcycle arriving at the main gate, where the passenger threw the crude bomb before fleeing.

Police are currently reviewing the footage and investigating the incident to identify and take action against those involved.

The Home Minister has stated that two individuals responsible for the blast have already been identified.

#Bangladesh #SupremeCourt #Dhaka #BreakingNews #LawAndOrder

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo
